_comment: C0-15 text-generation-webui bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」2 行带 .md 链接（koboldcpp/llama-cpp），related 写 2 条（frontmatter related 是 [openai-agents-sdk]，键按正文链接行对齐=2）。sources 3 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: GGUF/safetensors multi-backend (the llama.cpp/exllama-line loader ecosystem); the model/loader matrix not inventoried item by item.
axes.runtime: A local WebUI (the Gradio line) + command line; GitHub 47,728★, last push 2026-08-17 (GitHub API verified 2026-10-30). The repo is now named oobabooga/textgen (the old name text-generation-webui 301-redirects, direct-fetch verified).
axes.local_files: Fully local: models, conversations and extension data live in your own environment; no official cloud line or telemetry statement seen.
axes.background: A built-in OpenAI-compatible API server extension line; details not verified item by item.
axes.tools: The extensions ecosystem is one of the main axes; MCP not verified item by item.
axes.context: Context length and chat-template management are core surfaces; long-context trimming-strategy details not verified item by item.
axes.permissions: A local process with no account system; the WebUI listens locally by default, sharing/public exposure requires the user's own configuration.
axes.fit: Fits: wanting extension-ecosystem and multi-loader flexibility, community play (character cards/fine-tuning handoffs). Does not fit: wanting minimal out-of-the-box simplicity (the UI is information-dense); closed-source distribution built on a license other than AGPL.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The closest test protocol is the code-side [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md) (the local-endpoint and credential-boundary sections are reusable; no runner-specific protocol exists on this site yet).
unknowns:
- The full loader matrix (version correspondences of llama.cpp/exllama etc. not verified item by item)
- The current activity of the extensions ecosystem (a third-party ecosystem, not inventoried item by item)
- An official explanation of the rename (to textgen) (no announcement direct-fetched — only the repo-name fact recorded)
related: Both AGPL community GUIs: KoboldCpp travels light as a single file, TGW deploys heavy with extensions.
The underlying layer of one of the multi loaders; TGW's value is the interface and extensions above the loaders.
